purpose: Cris can track and pause his Gemini subscription in ACS the way he does Claude, ChatGPT (codex) and Grok: a Gemini seat on the Usage page, run through the Antigravity CLI (agy), showing its 5-hour and weekly limits, and Pause on the Gemini pool only. ACS never handles agy credentials.
mechanism: lib/usage/gemini.js readGeminiSeat: locates the real agy (locateBinary, past the cmux wrapper), runs `agy --version` then `agy -p /usage --output-format json` with pinned argv from a fresh empty mkdtemp folder, stdin ignored, CMUX_ANTIGRAVITY_HOOKS_DISABLED=1, under one 20 s deadline (the usage CLI itself is killed at 30 s). Refuses agy below 1.1.11 (older print mode sent /usage to the model as a prompt). shapeUsage accepts a reply only when command.name is 'usage' and num_turns is 0; windows = the 'Gemini Models' 5h and weekly buckets (usedPercent = (1 - remaining_fraction) * 100, stored unrounded, rounded only on screen), extraWindows = the 'Gemini 4 Argon' weekly bucket; the 'Claude and GPT models' group is dropped. Exit 2 means an API-key login (no subscription quota) and gives that reason; every reading records agyVersion. lib/usage/seats.js: VENDORS gains 'gemini'; a gemini seat has harness 'agy' (the only allowed value), no home, one per machine (validateSeat); detectSeats suggests it when agy is installed or ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli exists, and not when any gemini seat exists; saveSeats writes back entries this build cannot read, addSeat refuses an id held by one, uniqueSeatId avoids them. bin/usage.mjs: `acs usage detect` passes binaries.agy from locateBinary and `--save` prints each id registered. lib/usage/refresh.js hands the worker the server's login-shell PATH dirs in ACS_LOGIN_PATH_DIRS, which lib/login-path.js seeds its cache from, so the worker finds the agy Setup found. lib/harness.js knows agy candidates. server.js installedClis includes agy; seat routes pass harness. public/app.js and setup.js: one shared Add picker (Gemini → through Antigravity); public/usage-view.js shows the Argon line without a gauge; cards on Usage and Home show the harness; Pause works on the gemini account. tests/guards.mjs agyUsageOnly pins each gemini.js spawn exactly (binary, argv, options literal, temp folder).
decisions: windows hold only the Gemini Models pool because that is what a gemini pause covers; Argon is a separate Pro-plan quota so it is shown but never times a pause; the Claude/GPT group is dropped because Cris never runs those through Antigravity. harness is stored on the seat now so opencode can be added later without migrating seats (rejected: deriving it from the vendor). GEMINI_API_KEY is left alone; changing it would silently switch agy's login. /credits is not read (balance 0, a second spawn). usedPercent stored unrounded so Pause compares true values (rejected: rounding at read time). Unknown seat entries are preserved so an ACS build that does not know a vendor never deletes its seat; older installed builds still can until updated.
readers: README Subscription usage section and acs usage CLI help → users adding and pausing subscriptions; packs/README and KNOWN-LIMITS → people configuring ACS and packs; code comments → the next maintainer of lib/usage.
